title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. The ambient space is the compactified moduli stack M̄_{g,ν}, written D_0, whose boundary D is a divisor with normal crossings. A chain d_* = {d_0 > d_1 > … > d_r ≥ 0} indexes a 'flagged' boundary stratum D_{d_*}. This stratum is the normalisation of the locus of curves with d_0 nodes, equipped with a nested choice of subsets S_r ⊂ … ⊂ S_1 ⊂ S_0 of local branches (nodes), with |S_i| = d_i.

- For a subchain d'_* ⊂ d_* there is a forgetful local immersion D_{d_*} → D_{d'_*}.
- Ň denotes the normal bundle; the check marks the dual of Grothendieck's conormal N. The exact sequences (284), (285) and (288) are normal-bundle sequences, not conormal ones. 'Conormal' is crossed out on the previous page.
- Locally Ň_{d_*} = Ň_{D_{d_*},D_0} = ⊕_{b∈S_0} L_b is a sum of the normal line bundles of the branches.
- Ň_{d_*,d_i} := Ň_{D_{d_*},D_{d_i}} = ⊕_{b∈S_0∖S_i} L_b has rank d_0 − d_i.
- These subbundles form a canonical filtration of Ň_{d_*} indexed by the chain, from Ň_{d_*,d_0} = 0 up to Ň_{d_*,0} = Ň_{d_*}.

This page. For d''_0 ≤ d'_0 in d_*, Grothendieck takes the most general canonical subquotient (286): Ň_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)} := Ň_{d_*,d''_0}/Ň_{d_*,d'_0}. Locally this is ⊕_{b∈S'∖S''} L_b, of rank d'_0 − d''_0. It sits in the exact sequence (287).

He then reinterprets (287) through the tower D_{d_*} → D_{d'_*} → D_{d''_*}, where d''_* ⊂ d'_* ⊂ d_* are the tails of d_* starting at d''_0 and d'_0. This gives the standard transitivity sequence of normal bundles for X → Y → Z (288): 0 → N_{X/Y} → N_{X/Z} → N_{Y/Z}|_X → 0. It identifies the subquotient with the restricted normal bundle of D_{d'_*} in D_{d''_*}.

Purpose. On the next page the local splitting into line bundles yields open 'deleted' parts N* (torsors under tori; the coordinate hyperplanes are removed). Inverse images of these give torsors fibred over one another. This is the algebraic skeleton of an iterated punctured tubular neighbourhood of the boundary strata, used to describe the 'structure at infinity' (homotopy type near the boundary) of M_{g,ν}.
errors: The previous page's filtration, as transcribed (Ň_{d_*} = Ň_{d_*,d_0} ⊃ … ⊃ Ň_{d_*,0} = 0), has the ends and the inclusion direction reversed relative to (283), (285), (286) and (288). Consistency requires Ň_{d_*,d_i} = Ň_{D_{d_*},D_{d_i}} of rank d_0 − d_i, increasing as d_i decreases: 0 = Ň_{d_*,d_0} ⊂ … ⊂ Ň_{d_*,0} = Ň_{d_*}. This is either a slip by Grothendieck or a misreading of indices. With the corrected direction, the quotient in (286) makes sense; with the transcribed direction it would be the wrong way round.
Notational ambiguity: D_{d_i} must be read as D_{d'_*} for the tail subchain {d_i > … > d_r}, not as the unflagged stratum D_{{d_i}}. This is made explicit only in (285) and (288).
The sequences are correct only if Ň is the normal bundle (dual of the conormal). With conormal bundles the sub and quotient terms would be swapped.

ideas.what: Canonical filtration of the normal bundle of a flagged stratum of a normal crossings boundary divisor, indexed by the flag, and its general subquotients
ideas.modern_name: Normal bundle filtration along a chain of strata of an snc/normal crossings divisor (stratified / log geometry)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard; implicit in Deligne's mixed Hodge theory (weight filtrations) and in log geometry (Kato)

ideas.what: Transitivity exact sequence of normal bundles for X → Y → Z, identifying the subquotient with N_{Y/Z}|_X
ideas.modern_name: Normal bundle sequence for a tower of (local) immersions
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical; EGA IV §16 for the conormal version

ideas.what: Preparation for iterated deleted tubular neighbourhoods (torus torsors N* ⊂ N) modelling the structure at infinity of M_{g,ν}
ideas.modern_name: Real oriented blow-up / Kato–Nakayama space; Harvey bordification boundary; 'tube at infinity' of moduli
ideas.usually_credited_to: Harvey (1979), Kato–Nakayama (1999), Looijenga; Grothendieck's own programme in Esquisse d'un programme (1984)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the structure at infinity / Teichmüller tower only qualitatively

deep.surprise_reason: Routine bookkeeping of normal bundles along flagged boundary strata, preparing torus-torsor tubular neighbourhoods. It is mathematically standard and already well represented in the literature on the boundary structure of M̄_{g,n}; it is only of archival interest as part of Grothendieck's detailed 'structure à l'infini' notes.
transcription_corrections: First line: 'La question canonique la plus générale associée' should read 'Le quotient canonique le plus général associé à la filtration 282 est le fibré vectoriel'.

Last lines: 'Donc, du coup[?] de ces fibrés vectoriels Ň/(calculant[?] le plus général est donc[?] …)' likely reads 'Donc, chacun de ces fibrés vectoriels Ň (dont le plus général est donc Ň_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)}) …'.
'peut s'interpréter aussi[?]' is plausibly 'peut s'interpréter aussi' or 'peut s'interpréter ainsi'.
Condition line: 'd''_0 ≤ d'_0 (≤ d_0)' confirmed. The tail sets are {d''_0 > … > d''_{r''}} and {d'_0 > … > d'_{r'}}.
